context.transcript:
Lina, I wanted to talk to you about the script you submitted for our upcoming radio commercial, the one advertising our electric stoves.
Oh, yes.
I wasn't sure about including the slogan, the one that goes, you can count on Plymouth appliances, will make your kitchen our priority.
You're right.
I think we'll have to take that out.
We only have 30 seconds of audio, so we'll have to shorten the script.
Well, I'm worried about our deadline.
The script has to be ready by the end of the week.
We've already reserved time in the recording studio.
context.transcript_translation:
Lina，我想和你谈谈你提交的关于我们即将播出的电炉广告的剧本。
哦，是的。
我不确定是否应该包含口号，就是说 'you can count on Plymouth appliances, will make your kitchen our priority'（你可以信赖普利茅斯电器，让你的厨房成为我们的优先事项）。
你说得对。
我想我们必须去掉它。
我们只有 30 秒的音频时间，所以我们必须缩短剧本。
嗯，我担心我们的截止日期。
剧本必须在本周末前准备好。
我们已经预订了录音室的时间。
